gravity_story.description_zh: 从地心说到广义相对论，探索宇宙中最神秘的力量。
gravity_story.description_en: From geocentrism to general relativity, exploring the universe's most mysterious force.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
起初，[亚里士多德](aristotle_geocentrism_BC350)和[托勒密](ptolemy_geocentrism_150)让我们相信地球是宇宙不动的中心。这种直觉统治了千年，直到[哥白尼](copernicus_heliocentrism_1543)大胆地让地球动了起来。为了证明这一点，[第谷](tycho_brahe_astronomical_data_1580)穷尽一生记录了星空数据，而[开普勒](kepler_laws_1609)从中发现了行星运动的三大定律。随后，[伽利略](galileo_motion_1638)用望远镜看到了木星的卫星，彻底粉碎了地心说。

但行星为什么会绕太阳转？[胡克](hooke_inverse_square_1679)猜到了平方反比关系，而[牛顿](newton_gravity_1687)用万有引力定律给出了数学证明，[哈雷](halley_comet_1705)利用它准确预言了彗星的回归。后来，[卡文迪许](cavendish_experiment_1798)称出了地球的重量，勒维耶甚至仅靠笔尖计算就发现了[海王星](discovery_of_neptune_1846)。

然而，这套完美的理论却搞不定[水星](mercury_perihelion_1859)的一点点偏差。为了修补它，[爱因斯坦](einstein_general_relativity_1915)提出了广义相对论，认为引力是时空的弯曲。[爱丁顿](eddington_eclipse_1919)在日食观测中证实了光线的弯曲，[奥本海默](oppenheimer_snyder_black_hole_1939)预言了时空极度弯曲的产物——黑洞。最终，[LIGO](ligo_gravitational_waves_2015)听到了两个黑洞碰撞出的引力波，证明爱因斯坦是对的。
narrative_intro.text_en:
It began with [Aristotle](aristotle_geocentrism_BC350) and [Ptolemy](ptolemy_geocentrism_150) placing Earth at the center. This intuition ruled for millennia until [Copernicus](copernicus_heliocentrism_1543) dared to move the Earth. [Tycho Brahe](tycho_brahe_astronomical_data_1580) recorded the stars, and [Kepler](kepler_laws_1609) found the laws of planetary motion. [Galileo](galileo_motion_1638) then saw Jupiter's moons, shattering geocentrism.

But why do planets orbit? [Hooke](hooke_inverse_square_1679) guessed the inverse square law, and [Newton](newton_gravity_1687) proved it with gravity. [Halley](halley_comet_1705) predicted a comet, and [Cavendish](cavendish_experiment_1798) weighed the Earth. Le Verrier even found [Neptune](discovery_of_neptune_1846) with just a pen.

Yet, the theory failed [Mercury](mercury_perihelion_1859). [Einstein](einstein_general_relativity_1915) fixed it with General Relativity—gravity as curved spacetime. [Eddington](eddington_eclipse_1919) confirmed it during an eclipse, and [Oppenheimer](oppenheimer_snyder_black_hole_1939) predicted black holes. Finally, [LIGO](ligo_gravitational_waves_2015) heard gravitational waves, proving Einstein right.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 引力是一种拉力，还是时空的形状？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Is gravity a pulling force, or the shape of spacetime?

electricity_story.description_zh: 从微弱火花到驱动世界的芯片，人类如何驾驭电子。
electricity_story.description_en: From faint sparks to chips that drive the world, how humanity tamed the electron.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
人类对电的认识始于[泰勒斯](thales_anaximander_BC580)摩擦琥珀时的微弱火花。千年后，[吉尔伯特](gilbert_de_magnete_1600)发现地球本身就是磁体，[格里克](guericke_static_generator_1663)制造了摩擦发电机，而[莱顿瓶](leyden_jar_1745)学会了储存这股力量。当[富兰克林](franklin_kite_1752)用风筝引下天电证明闪电也是电时，[库仑](coulomb_law_1785)给出了电荷间作用力的数学公式。

[伽伐尼](galvani_animal_electricity_1791)误以为那是“生物电”，但[伏特](volta_battery_1800)用电池证明了电可以用化学产生，带来了稳定的电流。随后奇迹发生了：[奥斯特](oersted_electromagnetism_1820)发现电能生磁，[安培](ampere_law_1826)将其公式化，而[法拉第](faraday_induction_1831)实现了磁能生电——发电机诞生了。[麦克斯韦](maxwell_equations_1861)用一组方程统一了电与磁，并预言了电磁波。于是，[爱迪生](edison_light_bulb_1879)用电点亮了黑夜，[特斯拉](tesla_ac_motor_1887)用交流电驱动了工厂，[赫兹](hertz_waves_1887)证实了电磁波，[马可尼](marconi_radio_1895)用它实现了无线通信。

最后，[弗莱明](fleming_diode_1904)发明了真空管，[肖克利](transistor_invention_1947)把它进化成了晶体管，基尔比把它缩小成[集成电路](integrated_circuit_1958)。电，从此变成了信息的载体。
narrative_intro.text_en:
It started with [Thales](thales_anaximander_BC580) rubbing amber. Later, [Gilbert](gilbert_de_magnete_1600) studied magnets, [Guericke](guericke_static_generator_1663) built generators, and the [Leyden Jar](leyden_jar_1745) stored charge. [Franklin](franklin_kite_1752) proved lightning was electricity, and [Coulomb](coulomb_law_1785) measured the force.

[Galvani](galvani_animal_electricity_1791) thought it was biological, but [Volta](volta_battery_1800) created the battery. Then, [Oersted](oersted_electromagnetism_1820) linked electricity to magnetism, [Ampere](ampere_law_1826) formulated it, and [Faraday](faraday_induction_1831) created the generator. [Maxwell](maxwell_equations_1861) unified them and predicted waves. [Edison](edison_light_bulb_1879) lit the world, [Tesla](tesla_ac_motor_1887) powered industry, [Hertz](hertz_waves_1887) proved waves existed, and [Marconi](marconi_radio_1895) sent them wirelessly.

Finally, [Fleming](fleming_diode_1904) made the vacuum tube, [Shockley](transistor_invention_1947) the transistor, and Kilby the [Integrated Circuit](integrated_circuit_1958). Electricity became information.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 这股看不见的流体，如何成为了现代文明的血液？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: How did this invisible fluid become the blood of modern civilization?

light_story.description_zh: 是粒子还是波？一场持续300年的大辩论，最终催生了量子力学。
light_story.description_en: Particle or Wave? A 300-year debate that birthed Quantum Mechanics.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
光是什么？[墨子](mozi_optics_BC400)和[海什木](ibn_al_haytham_optics_1021)最早发现了小孔成像，认为光是直线的。[笛卡尔](descartes_optics_1637)和[格里马尔迪](grimaldi_diffraction_1665)发现了折射和衍射，暗示光并不简单。随后，[罗默](roemer_speed_of_light_1676)通过观测木卫食，首次证实了光速是有限的，而非瞬间传播。

紧接着，物理学界爆发了内战：[牛顿](newton_opticks_1704)坚持光是粒子，而[惠更斯](huygens_wave_theory_1678)认为是波。凭借牛顿的权威，粒子说统治了百年。直到[托马斯·杨](young_double_slit_1803)的双缝实验展示了干涉条纹，[菲涅耳](fresnel_diffraction_1818)完善了波动数学，加上[斐索](fizeau_speed_of_light_1849)在地面测出的光速，波动说似乎赢了。特别是当[麦克斯韦](maxwell_equations_1861)证明光就是电磁波时，争论似乎终结了。但是，[迈克尔逊](michelson_morley_1887)的实验却找不到传播光所需的“以太”。

为了解决黑体辐射危机，[普朗克](planck_quantum_1900)无奈引入了能量子，[爱因斯坦](einstein_photoelectric_1905)用光电效应证明光确实也是粒子。我们终于接受了“波粒二象性”。基于此，人类发明了[激光](laser_invention_1960)和[光纤](fiber_optics_1966)，用纯净的光编织了互联网。
narrative_intro.text_en:
What is light? [Mozi](mozi_optics_BC400) and [Al-Haytham](ibn_al_haytham_optics_1021) saw it travel straight. [Descartes](descartes_optics_1637) and [Grimaldi](grimaldi_diffraction_1665) saw refraction and diffraction, while [Roemer](roemer_speed_of_light_1676) proved its speed was finite.

Then came the civil war: [Newton](newton_opticks_1704) said particle, [Huygens](huygens_wave_theory_1678) said wave. Newton ruled for a century. Then [Young's](young_double_slit_1803) double-slit experiment showed interference, [Fresnel](fresnel_diffraction_1818) did the math, and [Fizeau](fizeau_speed_of_light_1849) measured its speed on Earth. Waves were winning. [Maxwell](maxwell_equations_1861) proved light was an electromagnetic wave. But [Michelson](michelson_morley_1887) couldn't find the 'ether'.

To solve the black body crisis, [Planck](planck_quantum_1900) introduced quanta, and [Einstein](einstein_photoelectric_1905) proved light was also a particle. We accepted duality. From this, we built [Lasers](laser_invention_1960) and [Fiber Optics](fiber_optics_1966).
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 它是粒子还是波？为什么不能两者都是？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Is it a particle or a wave? Why not both?

thermo_story.description_zh: 从蒸汽机到宇宙热寂，探索能量、混乱度与时间的单向流动。
thermo_story.description_en: From steam engines to heat death, exploring energy, entropy, and the arrow of time.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
故事始于对动力的渴望。[纽科门](newcomen_engine_1712)和[瓦特](watt_steam_engine_1776)改良了蒸汽机，让人类拥有了超越马匹的力量。为了搞清蒸汽机的极限，[卡诺](carnot_thermodynamics_1824)提出了理想热机模型。随后，[焦耳](joule_heat_1843)证明了热也是一种能量，[开尔文](kelvin_absolute_zero_1848)定义了绝对零度，能量守恒定律确立。

但[克劳修斯](clausius_thermodynamics_1850)发现了一个可怕的事实：能量虽然守恒，但“有用”的能量却在不断减少。他提出了“熵”——混乱度的度量，预言了宇宙终将归于死寂的[热寂](heat_death_theory_1867)。尽管[麦克斯韦](maxwell_demon_1867)试图用“妖”来逆转这一过程，但[玻尔兹曼](boltzmann_statistical_mechanics_1877)用统计力学无情地证明了熵增是概率的必然。最后，[香农](shannon_entropy_1948)发现信息其实就是负熵，对抗混乱的唯一方式，就是创造信息和秩序。
narrative_intro.text_en:
It began with the hunger for power. [Newcomen](newcomen_engine_1712) and [Watt](watt_steam_engine_1776) built engines stronger than horses. [Carnot](carnot_thermodynamics_1824) defined their theoretical limit. [Joule](joule_heat_1843) proved heat is energy, and [Kelvin](kelvin_absolute_zero_1848) defined absolute zero.

But [Clausius](clausius_thermodynamics_1850) found a dark truth: energy is conserved, but 'useful' energy is lost. He defined 'Entropy', predicting the [Heat Death](heat_death_theory_1867) of the universe. [Maxwell's Demon](maxwell_demon_1867) tried to fight it, but [Boltzmann](boltzmann_statistical_mechanics_1877) proved entropy is a statistical certainty. Finally, [Shannon](shannon_entropy_1948) realized information is negative entropy. The only way to fight chaos is to create information.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 如果能量守恒，为什么时间不能倒流？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: If energy is conserved, why can't time flow backwards?

quantum_story.description_zh: 上帝掷骰子吗？见证人类最强大脑如何颠覆现实。
quantum_story.description_en: Does God play dice? Witness how the greatest minds rewrote reality.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
为了解决一朵乌云，[普朗克](planck_quantum_1900)被迫释放了量子幽灵。[爱因斯坦](einstein_photoelectric_1905)紧随其后证明了光量子。在原子内部，[卢瑟福](rutherford_nucleus_1911)发现了原子核，[玻尔](bohr_atom_1913)画出了电子轨道。但事情很快变得诡异：[德布罗意](de_broglie_matter_waves_1924)说物质也是波。

年轻的天才们登场了：[泡利](pauli_exclusion_principle_1925)制定了电子排队规则，[海森堡](heisenberg_matrix_mechanics_1925)用矩阵描述不可测的电子，[薛定谔](schrodinger_equation_1926)写出了著名的波动方程，而[波恩](born_wavefunction_1926)说这一切只是概率。这引出了[测不准原理](heisenberg_uncertainty_1927)，并在[索尔维会议](solvay_conference_1927)上引发了爱因斯坦与玻尔的世纪论战。

[狄拉克](dirac_equation_1928)将相对论引入量子力学，预言了反物质；[查德威克](chadwick_neutron_1932)发现了中子。但最令人不安的是量子纠缠，爱因斯坦称之为[EPR悖论](entanglement_epr_1935)。直到多年后，[贝尔定理](bell_theorem_1964)证明：上帝真的在掷骰子，而且世界比我们想象的更离奇。
narrative_intro.text_en:
To solve a crisis, [Planck](planck_quantum_1900) unleashed the quantum ghost. [Einstein](einstein_photoelectric_1905) proved light quanta. [Rutherford](rutherford_nucleus_1911) found the nucleus, and [Bohr](bohr_atom_1913) drew electron orbits. Then [De Broglie](de_broglie_matter_waves_1924) said matter is also a wave.

The young geniuses arrived: [Pauli](pauli_exclusion_principle_1925) made rules for electrons, [Heisenberg](heisenberg_matrix_mechanics_1925) used matrices, [Schrodinger](schrodinger_equation_1926) wrote the wave equation, and [Born](born_wavefunction_1926) said it's all probability. This led to [Uncertainty](heisenberg_uncertainty_1927) and the great debates at [Solvay](solvay_conference_1927).

[Dirac](dirac_equation_1928) united it with relativity; [Chadwick](chadwick_neutron_1932) found the neutron. But [EPR](entanglement_epr_1935) entanglement haunted Einstein. Years later, [Bell's Theorem](bell_theorem_1964) proved: God does play dice, and reality is weirder than we thought.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 如果世界本质是概率的，那什么是真实的？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: If reality is probabilistic, what is real?

micro_story.description_zh: 从胡克的软木塞到抗生素，人类如何发现并战胜看不见的敌人。
micro_story.description_en: From Hooke's cork to antibiotics, how humanity conquered invisible enemies.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
我们曾以为疾病是诅咒。直到[胡克](hooke_micrographia_1665)透过显微镜看到了细胞，[列文虎克](leeuwenhoek_bacteria_1676)看到了细菌，一个微观宇宙才被打开。[詹纳](jenner_vaccine_1796)用牛痘开启了免疫学，而[施莱登](schleiden_schwann_cell_theory_1839)确立了细胞学说。

但在医院里，产妇还在死去，直到[塞麦尔维斯](semmelweis_handwashing_1847)恳求医生洗手。[巴斯德](pasteur_germ_theory_1861)最终证实了细菌致病说，否定了自然发生论。[李斯特](lister_antiseptic_1867)引入消毒，[科赫](koch_postulates_1876)制定了黄金法则，[哈尔斯特德](halsted_surgical_gloves_1890)戴上了橡胶手套，手术终于不再是屠杀。接着，更小的敌人——病毒被[伊万诺夫斯基](ivanovsky_virus_1892)和[贝杰林克](beijerinck_virus_concept_1898)发现，并被[斯坦利](stanley_crystallization_1935)结晶化。

反击开始了：[弗莱明](fleming_penicillin_1928)偶然发现了青霉素，经[弗洛里](florey_chain_penicillin_1941)量产，成为了二战救命药。[瓦克斯曼](waksman_streptomycin_1943)发现了链霉素征服结核病。最终，[霍奇金](dorothy_hodgkin_insulin_1969)看清了这些分子的结构，让我们从仅仅是观察生命，走向了理解生命。
narrative_intro.text_en:
We thought disease was a curse. Then [Hooke](hooke_micrographia_1665) saw cells, and [Leeuwenhoek](leeuwenhoek_bacteria_1676) saw bacteria. [Jenner](jenner_vaccine_1796) started immunology, and [Schleiden](schleiden_schwann_cell_theory_1839) defined cell theory.

But death remained until [Semmelweis](semmelweis_handwashing_1847) begged doctors to wash hands. [Pasteur](pasteur_germ_theory_1861) proved germs cause disease. [Lister](lister_antiseptic_1867) sterilized, [Koch](koch_postulates_1876) set the rules, and [Halsted](halsted_surgical_gloves_1890) wore gloves. Then, viruses were found by [Ivanovsky](ivanovsky_virus_1892) and [Beijerinck](beijerinck_virus_concept_1898), and crystallized by [Stanley](stanley_crystallization_1935).

The counterattack began: [Fleming](fleming_penicillin_1928) found penicillin, [Florey](florey_chain_penicillin_1941) mass-produced it. [Waksman](waksman_streptomycin_1943) cured TB. Finally, [Hodgkin](dorothy_hodgkin_insulin_1969) revealed their structures. We moved from observing life to understanding it.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 是我们战胜了微生物，还是学会了与它们共存？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Did we conquer microbes, or learn to coexist?

gene_story.description_zh: 从达尔文到CRISPR，探索生命是如何被“编程”的。
gene_story.description_en: From Darwin to CRISPR. Exploring how life is 'programmed'.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
[达尔文](darwin_evolution_1859)告诉我们生命在演化，[孟德尔](mendel_genetics_1866)用豌豆算出了遗传的数学规律。但遗传物质到底是什么？[米歇尔](miescher_nuclein_1869)在绷带里发现了 DNA，[摩尔根](morgan_fruit_fly_1910)用果蝇把基因定位在染色体上。虽然[格里菲斯](griffith_experiment_1928)发现了转化现象，[薛定谔](schrodinger_what_is_life_1944)预言了生命密码，但直到[艾弗里](avery_dna_principle_1944)才确认 DNA 才是主角。

随后是疯狂的结构竞赛：[查加夫](chargaff_rules_1950)发现了碱基配对，[威尔金斯](wilkins_dna_diffraction_1950)和[富兰克林](franklin_photo_51_1952)拍下了关键的 X 射线照片，[鲍林](pauling_alpha_helix_1951)在错误模型上跌倒，最终[沃森和克里克](watson_crick_dna_1953)解开了双螺旋之谜。克里克提出了[中心法则](crick_central_dogma_1958)，[霍奇金](dorothy_hodgkin_insulin_1969)解析了蛋白质。

进入新世纪，[人类基因组计划](human_genome_project_2003)读完了整本天书。然后我们学会了改写：从[CRISPR](crispr_gene_editing_2012)这把大剪刀，到改变种群的[基因驱动](gene_drive_2014)，再到精准的[碱基编辑](base_editing_2016)、[先导编辑](prime_editing_2019)和[双先导编辑](twin_prime_editing_2021)。人类终于拿起了改写上帝代码的笔。
narrative_intro.text_en:
[Darwin](darwin_evolution_1859) saw evolution, and [Mendel](mendel_genetics_1866) found the math of heredity. But what was the material? [Miescher](miescher_nuclein_1869) found DNA, and [Morgan](morgan_fruit_fly_1910) mapped it to chromosomes. [Griffith](griffith_experiment_1928) saw transformation, and [Schrodinger](schrodinger_what_is_life_1944) predicted code, but [Avery](avery_dna_principle_1944) confirmed DNA was the key.

Then came the race: [Chargaff](chargaff_rules_1950) found the rules, [Wilkins](wilkins_dna_diffraction_1950) and [Franklin](franklin_photo_51_1952) took the photos, [Pauling](pauling_alpha_helix_1951) stumbled, and [Watson & Crick](watson_crick_dna_1953) solved the Double Helix. [Crick](crick_central_dogma_1958) defined the dogma, [Hodgkin](dorothy_hodgkin_insulin_1969) saw the protein.

We read the [Genome](human_genome_project_2003). Then we learned to write: from [CRISPR](crispr_gene_editing_2012) scissors to [Gene Drives](gene_drive_2014), [Base Editing](base_editing_2016), [Prime](prime_editing_2019), and [Twin Prime](twin_prime_editing_2021). We now hold the pen to rewrite life.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 当我们能重写生命代码时，我们还是人类吗？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: When we rewrite the code of life, are we still human?

computing_origin_story.description_zh: 从莱布尼茨的二进制到IBM PC，人类如何发明了“电子大脑”。
computing_origin_story.description_en: From Leibniz's binary to the IBM PC, how humanity invented the 'electronic brain'.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
一切始于[莱布尼茨](leibniz_binary_1703)的疯狂想法，他发现世界可以用二进制的 0 和 1 来描述。一百多年后，[巴贝奇](babbage_analytical_engine_1837)画出了分析机的机械蓝图，而[洛夫莱斯](lovelace_first_program_1843)为它写下了人类第一段程序。随后，[布尔](boole_logic_1854)发明了布尔代数，将逻辑变成了数学运算。

直到 20 世纪，[图灵](turing_machine_1936)提出了图灵机的理论模型，[香农](shannon_circuits_1937)证明了开关电路可以实现逻辑，计算机才真正有了灵魂。从[ABC](abc_computer_1942)的电子尝试，到[冯·诺依曼](von_neumann_architecture_1945)确立存储程序架构，再到庞然大物[ENIAC](eniac_computer_1945)的诞生，机器终于学会了计算。随后，[晶体管](transistor_invention_1947)让它变小，香农的[信息论](shannon_entropy_1948)让它能说话，[UNIVAC](univac_1_1951)让它走进商业，[集成电路](integrated_circuit_1958)让它印在硅片上。

恩格尔巴特的[演示之母](engelbart_demo_1968)让我们看到了鼠标和交互的未来。紧接着，[Intel 4004](intel_4004_1971)把大脑缩小到指甲盖大，[IBM PC](ibm_pc_1981)定义了它的身体。至此，电子大脑完全成型，等待着软件赋予它灵魂。
narrative_intro.text_en:
It began with [Leibniz's](leibniz_binary_1703) binary dream. Centuries later, [Babbage](babbage_analytical_engine_1837) designed the engine, and [Lovelace](lovelace_first_program_1843) wrote the code. [Boole](boole_logic_1854) turned thought into math.

Then [Turing](turing_machine_1936) defined the machine, and [Shannon](shannon_circuits_1937) proved circuits could think. From the [ABC](abc_computer_1942) to the [Von Neumann Architecture](von_neumann_architecture_1945) and [ENIAC](eniac_computer_1945), the machine was born. The [Transistor](transistor_invention_1947) shrank it, [Information Theory](shannon_entropy_1948) gave it language, [UNIVAC](univac_1_1951) sold it, and the [Integrated Circuit](integrated_circuit_1958) printed it.

Engelbart's [Demo](engelbart_demo_1968) showed the future. Then, [Intel 4004](intel_4004_1971) created the microchip, and [IBM PC](ibm_pc_1981) built the body. The electronic brain had arrived, waiting for software to give it a soul.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 死寂的物质是如何学会思考的？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: How did inert matter learn to think?

digital_age_story.description_zh: 从芯片到互联网再到智能手机，硅谷如何重塑了现代人类的生活方式。
digital_age_story.description_en: From chips to the Web and smartphones, how Silicon Valley reshaped modern life.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
故事从[集成电路](integrated_circuit_1958)和[摩尔定律](moore_law_1965)的指数级预言开始。恩格尔巴特的[演示之母](engelbart_demo_1968)和[ARPANET](arpanet_1969)的连接埋下了未来的种子。随着[Intel 4004](intel_4004_1971)微处理器的诞生，硬件准备好了。紧接着，[Microsoft](microsoft_founding_1975)定义了软件产业，而[Apple](apple_founding_1976)在车库里定义了个人电脑。随后，[IBM PC](ibm_pc_1981)和[MS-DOS](ms_dos_1981)确立了行业标准，个人计算时代正式来临。

[Macintosh](apple_macintosh_1984)和[Windows](microsoft_windows_1985)用图形界面让电脑变得好用，而伯纳斯-李的[万维网](berners_lee_www_1989)让电脑不再孤单。[Linux](linux_kernel_1991)开启了开源时代，随后商业爆发了：[Amazon](amazon_founding_1994)建起了网上超市，[eBay](ebay_launch_1995)建起了集市，[Google](google_search_1998)整理了信息，[PayPal](paypal_launch_1998)打通了支付。

进入新世纪，[Wikipedia](wikipedia_launch_2001)让全人类共同书写知识，[Facebook](facebook_launch_2004)连接了人，[YouTube](youtube_launch_2005)开启了全民视频时代，[AWS](aws_launch_2006)把算力搬上了云端。最终，[iPhone](apple_iphone_2007)和[Android](google_android_2008)把互联网装进了口袋。数字浪潮，彻底淹没了旧世界。
narrative_intro.text_en:
It starts with the [Integrated Circuit](integrated_circuit_1958) and [Moore's Law](moore_law_1965). Engelbart's [Demo](engelbart_demo_1968) and [ARPANET](arpanet_1969) planted the seeds. [Intel 4004](intel_4004_1971) built the brain. Then, [Microsoft](microsoft_founding_1975) created the software business, and [Apple](apple_founding_1976) built the personal computer. With [IBM PC](ibm_pc_1981) and [MS-DOS](ms_dos_1981), personal computing arrived.

[Macintosh](apple_macintosh_1984) and [Windows](microsoft_windows_1985) gave it a face, while the [Web](berners_lee_www_1989) connected it all. [Linux](linux_kernel_1991) opened the code. Then came commerce: [Amazon](amazon_founding_1994) the store, [eBay](ebay_launch_1995) the market, [Google](google_search_1998) the map, and [PayPal](paypal_launch_1998) the wallet.

[Wikipedia](wikipedia_launch_2001) democratized knowledge, [Facebook](facebook_launch_2004) connected us, [YouTube](youtube_launch_2005) broadcast our lives, and [AWS](aws_launch_2006) built the cloud. Finally, [iPhone](apple_iphone_2007) and [Android](google_android_2008) put the world in our pockets. The digital wave reshaped everything.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 我们是更自由了，还是被算法困住了？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Are we freer, or trapped by algorithms?

ai_story.description_zh: 从深蓝到ChatGPT，见证机器如何从“计算”进化为“智能”。
ai_story.description_en: From Deep Blue to ChatGPT, witness the evolution from 'computing' to 'intelligence'.

narrative_intro.text_zh:
当[图灵机](turing_machine_1936)被构想出来时，图灵就问：机器能思考吗？[达特茅斯会议](dartmouth_ai_conference_1956)正式诞生了 AI 这个梦想。起初，我们试图用[专家系统](expert_systems_1980)教机器规则。

1986年，[反向传播](backprop_1986)算法赋予了神经网络学习的能力。基于此，[LeNet](lenet_1989) 证明了模仿大脑是可行的，但因算力不足而生不逢时。于是，依靠暴力计算的[深蓝](deep_blue_chess_1997)统治了 90 年代。直到[NVIDIA GPU](nvidia_gpu_1999)和[CUDA](cuda_release_2006)解锁了算力，[AlexNet](alexnet_2012)终于引爆了迟到的深度学习革命。紧接着，[AlphaGo](alphago_2016)学会了直觉，[Transformer](vaswani_transformer_2017)破解了语言，最终孕育出了[ChatGPT](chatgpt_launch_2022)。硅基智慧，终于觉醒。
narrative_intro.text_en:
When the [Turing Machine](turing_machine_1936) was conceived, Turing asked: Can machines think? [Dartmouth](dartmouth_ai_conference_1956) named the dream. We tried [Expert Systems](expert_system_1980) for rules.

In 1986, [Backpropagation](backprop_1986) gave neural nets the ability to learn. Based on this, [LeNet](lenet_1989) proved brain-like learning was possible but was limited by hardware. Thus, brute-force [Deep Blue](deep_blue_chess_1997) dominated the 90s. It wasn't until [NVIDIA GPU](nvidia_gpu_1999) and [CUDA](cuda_release_2006) unlocked the power that [AlexNet](alexnet_2012) sparked the Deep Learning revolution. Then, [AlphaGo](alphago_2016) learned intuition, the [Transformer](vaswani_transformer_2017) cracked language, birthing [ChatGPT](chatgpt_launch_2022). Silicon intelligence has awakened.
narrative_intro.core_question_zh: 硅基智慧会是我们的工具，还是后代？
narrative_intro.core_question_en: Is silicon intelligence our tool, or our descendant?
